profile: graph generation: Graph generation is the task of producing new graphs, and can be addressed with generative models. In graph learning, graph encoders map graph structure to node embeddings, while graph decoders map embeddings back to graphs. Graph generation involves this encoder-decoder mapping, and the central question is how to generate new graphs from learned representations.
